proposition.claim:
Equation1/Section3.1/Figure6 and AppendixA describe equivalent weighted MoE computation with a backward pipeline; p8 trains all MoE modules.

Algorithm1 constructs an evenly partitioned expert placement.

Section4.2 says similarity-based pruning consistently outperforms routing-based pruning.
